stdout_normalized:
usage: runtime/scripts/cli.py guard [-h] [--format {json,text}]
                                    [--mode {verdict,block-diff}]
                                    before after

positional arguments:
  before                the original file
  after                 the edited file, same type

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {json,text}  json (default, one document on stdout) or a readable
                        table
  --mode {verdict,block-diff}
                        block-diff prints each edited paragraph's old and new
                        text (always text; see docs/guard-block-diff.md)
